_doc: far_radius_m: past it a vehicle is drawn at the far level, its outline alone (no lamps, grille, plates nor mirrors, fewer stations and rows): a camera-wide MultiMesh has one box, so every shadow cascade draws its whole fleet. moto.shape, bicycle.rack and bicycle.spokes: the 4.0's own drawing of its two-wheelers. Car lines (top, screen, rear, belt, doors, tumble_m, nose_r, tail_r, lifts, bed_from) and the body's small measures (car_body): the 4.0's own drawing, no source behind them; only the dimensions, tyres, wheelbase, track and clearance come from the sheets. wagon: the sedan's sheet with the 4.0's estate lines, drawn for a third of the sedans. Lamps and trim colours head_lit, tail_lit, indicator, mirror, headlamp and tail (lenses off): the 4.0's too. Vehicles and people drawn by native/src/render/agents (spec world.md §5-§6). Metres; model frame +Z forward, +X the driver's left, Y up. The paints come by regional style (styles). trim: tyre the physicallybased.info Tire albedo (0.023 linear); hub and chrome light grey (the database's aluminium and chromium are metals, which these dielectric parts cannot show); under, blackout and grille black; the plate white (the Mercosul plate's ground, CONTRAN Resolução 969/2022); far glass blackish blue (a dark cabin under the sky's reflection); lamp lenses white and dark red; the truck's box white; the bus's air conditioning light grey: all ISCC-NBS centroids. Cars: the dimensions from each style's sheet (sedan Toyota Corolla: Toyota do Brasil, overhang, tracks and clearance from autotijd.be; hatch Hyundai HB20 2025: Hyundai catalogue and fichacompleta.com.br; SUV Jeep Compass T270: Jeep ficha técnica; van Renault Master L1H1: Autocosmos, its clearance the 546 mm load floor less sill_m; pickup Toyota Hilux double cab: Toyota and auto-data.net): length, width, height, tyre [width mm, aspect %, rim in], wheelbase_m, front_overhang_m (0: none given, the wheelbase centred), track_m [front, rear] (0: none given, the tyres flush with the sides), clearance. Car 'top' = roof line points [x share of length from the centre (front +0.5), y share of height], front to back; it and the glass, belt and plan lines are the reference's shapes, still to be measured on registered photos (pending). car_body: [fine (the cabin level), coarse] stations, steps round each arch and in each rounded end; the half ring's bottom corner radius bottom_round_m and the flank's bulge (share of the half width), measured on side and front photos of the reference cars at ~130 px/m (a 6-8 px corner, a 2 % wider waist); the B pillar b_pillar_m and the door seams door_seam_m wide (the seams drawn wider than a real 3-5 mm gap so they read at ~10 m, 1 px at 100 px/m); the wing mirror's housing [out, high, long] on its arm, the door handle [long, high, out], measured on the same photos. car_body.bumper_top_m: the ends' dark bumper face up to the top of the bumper zone, 20 in over the road (US 49 CFR Part 581, bumper standard). wheel_jump_m: a pose jump larger than this (respawn) does not turn the wheels. People: the cooked MakeHuman (CC0) bodies with the Rocketbox (MIT) walk in project/assets/people (tools/assets/cook_people.py); lod_m = camera distance where each level ends.

lod._doc: hold: how far past a level's edge, as a share of it, a vehicle or a walker changes level. How much of a level's surface may move, in metres, when its mesh is simplified (render/agents/agent_lod.h): under the width of a pixel at the level's nearest distance, lens of 35 degrees at 1080 lines (0.58 mm a metre away). Past cabin_close_m the cabin goes simplified, its glass and people still seen.

far_shadow._doc: What the far level casts (fleet_shadow.h): sectors of sector_m, each with its own box, so the near cascades leave them out; a car's hull scaled to each model, inset of its size so it never stands proud of the body it shades.

exhaust._doc: Tail smoke per class, for the particle system of the demolition port (it owns the puffs; this says when and where). Puffs a second: idle_per_s standing, moving_per_s plus per_speed for each m/s (at most moving_extra_max) past moving_from_ms. at: the pipe's mouth from the body's middle, x to its left, y up, z ahead. spread_m: scattered this much about it. Every number is the 4.0's (render/exhaust.ts: 0.15, 0.5, 0.02, 1, 0.5 m/s, 0.4 m high at the tail, 0.32 m, 0.96 m puffs of 2.6 s): no outside source. The body's ends come from the traffic classes; a bicycle has none.

styles._doc: What changes with a city's regional style (session-rules.md, section 10). paints: 16 slots a car draws from evenly. plate: to fill.

roadcraft._doc: The 4.0's look: the palettes of its hatch, sedan and first of its SUV, no source behind them.

brazil._doc: New cars: Axalta 2025 Global Automotive Color Popularity Report, South America: white 35, grey 23, silver 14, blue 7, red 4 %; black, ranked fourth with no figure, midway between blue and silver; largest remainders; each the ISCC-NBS centroid of its name. paints_fleet: what is registered, Veloe and Fipe over Senatran's data, end of 2024: white 21.7, black 18.9, silver 16.5, red 15.5, grey 10.9, blue 7.6, green 3.9 %, the rest about 1 % each, in one slot of ISCC-NBS grayish yellow, an unsourced stand-in; the whole fleet, motorcycles included.

usa._doc: To fill: the same Axalta report, region North America.

europe._doc: To fill: the same Axalta report, region Europe.

cars_cabin._doc: A car's cabin (agent_cabin over car_body.cpp): rows of two seats, as many as fit before the rear screen; the driver's hip point behind the windscreen's base (the ankles under it) by the front leg room's reach, the next row behind the front backrest by the rear one's (leg_room_m: SAE J1100 L33 and L51 of a Toyota Corolla 2023, 1 067 and 884 mm, each less the 254 mm the standard adds); each seat midway between the car's middle and its side; the dashboard from the windscreen back to the steering wheel and down to the knees. Colours: black (ISCC-NBS) lining, floor and dashboard, dark grey seats.

cabin._doc: Any vehicle's cabin behind its see-through glass, near the camera (cabin_radius_m; farther the body has no cabin and opaque glass): the lining lining_inset_m inside the body, the liner liner_drop_m under the roof, the steering wheel's rim steering_rim_m thick (drawn). person: who sits, from the medians of the 2012 US Army survey (ANSUR II, Gordon et al. 2014, NATICK/TR-15/007), men and women averaged: torso [chest breadth 279, shoulders over the seat: acromial height less the standing-to-sitting drop 583 (sitting height 888 - (stature 1691 - acromial height 1386)), chest depth 249 mm]; arm [(bideltoid breadth 480 - chest breadth) / 2, shoulder-elbow length 349, biceps circumference 331 / pi]; thigh [half the sitting hip breadth 388, thigh clearance 174, buttock-knee length 603 less half the chest depth and half the shin]; foot [breadth 98, lateral malleolus height 68, length 259]; shin_w the calf circumference 382 / pi; head_r the head circumference 567 / 2 pi; neck_m cervicale less acromial height (1455 - 1386); the hair (hair_drop, hair_back_m, long_hair_m) drawn; shoes black (ISCC-NBS). seats: car: the cushion as wide as the 95th percentile woman's sitting hip breadth (456) and as deep as the 5th percentile woman's buttock-popliteal length (441) (Pheasant & Haslegrave, Bodyspace, 3rd ed. 2006, seat design), its top hip_m over the floor (a midsize sedan's H30, 270 mm (UMTRI), less half the thigh), the backrest up to the shoulders and the headrest 170 wide up to 800 over the H-point along a torso leaning 25° back (FMVSS 202a; the H-point half the thigh over the cushion); the steering wheel [ahead of the backrest: chest depth / 2 + forearm-hand length 459 (the hands on the rim, the elbows bent), up: the elbows (shoulders less the upper arm), tilt back, radius, column: drawn]. cab: the operators' seat of ABNT NBR 15570 38.1 (width 400-500, depth 380-450, backrest 480-550, height 400-550, the wheel's centre 540-700 from the backrest: the middle of each). chair: the passengers' seat of NBR 15570 27.2 (a place on a double seat 860 / 2, depth 380-430, the high backrest 650 recommended, height 380-500: the middle of each) with a grab handle the yellow of the supports (24.1); cushion_m, back_d_m, base_share and the handle's size drawn.

occupants._doc: Who rides and how they look. skin: the albedo of the six Fitzpatrick skin types (physicallybased.info Skin I-VI, linear, here in sRGB), drawn with skin_weights: the user's rule, 80 % of the people light-skinned (types I-III, light_skins), shared equally within each group (no source tells them apart). hair: its colour from the people's hair palette (people.hair), hair_weights.light_skinned for the light-skinned (every colour alike) and .dark_skinned for the others (the four darkest alike: dark hair with dark skin, the user's rule); its cut with cuts [short, long, shaved]: long as often as the people are women (51.5 %, IBGE Censo 2022), short otherwise, none shaved. Clothes: the shirt and the trousers each drawn from the pedestrians' clothes (people.clothes); riders' helmets in the vehicles' paints. load, per kind of vehicle, how full its passenger seats run: bands = the share of vehicles in each of equal bands of fullness, from empty to every seat taken (one band per passenger count when there are seats + 1 bands); shuffle: the seats fill in an order of each vehicle's own (else front first). The driver is always there. Cars: a Poisson count of passengers with the mean of 1.4 people per car (CET-SP 2011), cut at the seats; buses and trucks: every band alike (no source).

moto._doc: Motorbike: Honda CG 160 (ficha técnica Honda 2024: 2.030 long, wheelbase 1.311, seat 0.796 high, tyres 80/100-18 front and 90/90-18 rear: front_tyre, tyre [width mm, aspect %, rim in]); body [width, bottom] drawn, its top under the saddle (saddle_m less the saddle's drawn thickness); the rider astride (cabin.person, metres, the left joints; the right mirrored), the hip on the saddle at the seat's height, the joints' offsets from it drawn; helmet_r its helmet (drawn).

bicycle._doc: City bicycle: 26 x 1.95 tyre (ETRTO 50-559, tyre [width mm, aspect %, rim in]); wheelbase, saddle height, bracket and head [z, y] of a medium frame, drawn; the rider astride, joints drawn like the motorbike's; helmet_r drawn.

bus._doc: Low-entry city bus, metres; z along it (front +), x to the driver's side (+X; the doors on the kerb side, -X). Body: Marcopolo Torino on the Mercedes-Benz O 500 U 1726 chassis: 12.5 long, 2.545 wide (length, width), 3.285 high with its roof air conditioning, so the body height 2.99 under a Spheros REVO-E Global 400 (ac_m: 3.10 x 1.90 x 0.295, the middle of its range, at the body's middle). Running gear from the chassis sheet (Mercedes-Benz do Brasil 2011): wheelbase 5.95, front overhang 2.486 plus half the body's 0.714 over the 11.786 chassis (front_overhang_m), tracks 2.101 / 1.821 (track_m: front, rear), tyres 295/80 R 22.5 (tyre: [width mm, aspect %, rim in]), the rear ones twin, dual_m apart (0.335, Nokian's least dual spacing for that tyre), 0.232 floor clearance (clearance); front and centre floor at 0.37 (floor; also the most ABNT NBR 15570:2009 Tabela 11 allows a low floor). Behind the last door the floor rises deck_steps steps of step_m [rise, tread] (the most and least NBR 15570 Tabela 8 allows with air suspension; one step: a low-entry rear is one or two steps up). Windows from sill_m over the low floor (the least NBR 15570 25.7 allows) to the liner, liner_m over the highest aisle floor (the least internal height, Tabela 5), none wider than window_max_m (25.6); the windscreen on the same line, the rear window sill_m over the deck. Doors door_m wide (the 1 100 mm door of 24.4) on the kerb side: the first behind the windscreen's corner pillar, the second midway between the axles. sign_m: the destination sign over the windscreen [height: 150 mm characters (Manaus SMTU Portaria 10/2012 after ABNT NBR 14022 7.2.3.1), in from each side]. rear_view_m: [glass bottom over the road, out of the body] (the least and the most NBR 15570 45.1.2-3). lamps_m: [centre height, outer edge in from the side, w, h] (UNECE R48: low beam 0.5-1.2 high, rear position lamps 0.35-1.5, each edge at most 0.4 from the side: the middle of each; the faces drawn). skirt_m: the dark rubbing strip along the bottom and the line under the windows [strip, line] (measured on the reference's side photo: 12 and 6 px at 145 px/m). wall_m: the walls drawn 4 cm thick.

interior._doc: Inside (agent_cabin): colours, the ISCC-NBS centroids (Kelly & Judd 1976) of what the reference shows: moderate blue seats, light bluish grey lining, bluish grey floor, a black dashboard; the stanchions yellow, Munsell 5Y 8/12 (NBR 15570 24.1) in sRGB. single_m the single seat between doubles in the back row (27.2.2 b), knee_m the free space ahead of a seat (27.2.9). wheelchair_m: the place kept for a wheelchair on the driver's side opposite the last door (the reserved area NBR 15570 4.3 counts in every class), as long as the wheelchair's reference module (ABNT NBR 9050: 0.80 x 1.20 m). pole_m: the stanchions' diameter (35.2: 30-40 mm, the middle) and the most between them along the aisle, alternating sides (35.5); rail_m the ceiling rails' height over the floor (35.7). partition_m: the panel behind the driver [height, gap over the floor] (34.1), glass above it to the liner. The driver's toes reach the pedals at the front wall; the dashboard runs from it back to the steering wheel and down to the knees.

truck._doc: Rigid truck: Volkswagen Delivery 11.180 (Brazil's best-selling truck in 2025), its 4 600 mm wheelbase (ficha técnica, VW Camiones y Buses Chile 2023): 8.485 long, front overhang 1.26, tyres 235/75 R 17.5, tracks 1.783 / 1.675, the rear twin tyres dual_m apart so their outer faces span the sheet's 2.190 rear width; the cab 2.115 wide (cab_w), its roof 2.452 high (cab_top), its back at the least distance the sheet lets a body start behind the front axle (body_from_axle_m 0.725); the mirrors out to its 2.685 width (mirror_out_m). The box: the recommended body length (5.986) from the back, the rear width wide, from the chassis' 0.869 platform to 3.10 (box_m [length, width, bottom, top]: the top measured on the reference's side photo, 133 px over the cab roof against the box's 437, with the sheet's cab and platform heights). The chassis' rails as wide apart as the sheet's 862 mm (rails_m). The cab sits over the front wheel (its bottom at the wheel's arch), its window line and glass top at cab_lines shares of the cab's height (measured on the same photo: 152 and 317 of 351 px). The wind deflector rises from the roof's front edge to the box's top. fuel_l: the plastic tank's 150 litres (sheet), fuel_tank_m [length, depth]. wall_m: the walls drawn 5 cm thick. lamps_m as the bus's. interior: colours, the ISCC-NBS centroids of what the reference shows: a dark grey cab, dark bluish grey seats, black floor and dashboard.

held._doc: What people hold (heldProps.ts of the 4.0), by act, in boxes: in the palm's frame, X along the fingers, Y to the thumb, Z out of the back of the hand; upright things hang round the fist with the body's axes. fist: where the fingers close, in the palm's frame.

blob._doc: Past from_m a person casts no real shadow and a soft disc lies under it: where a person stands about 20 pixels tall on 1080 lines through a 40 degree lens, as far as the Roadcraft 4.0 draws its crowd with real shadows (radius_m its disc, lift_m clear of the ground). The body is still its coarsest mesh there.

card._doc: A person is drawn as the card of its pictures (people_far.gdshader) only where the whole figure stands under below_px pixels on the screen: the Roadcraft 4.0's IMPOSTOR_PIXELS, where the coarsest mesh's error is past a pixel anyway. Measured by the frame's own lens (render/detail.h).
